summary: A mixed day dominated by retail regulatory changes and Reliance capital market activity, alongside judicial oversight orders on state compliance. Gold hallmarking fees spiked 67% while Reliance prepares a $1.3B rupee bond sale.

bullets.text: Gold hallmarking fees hiked 67% by BIS; new charges for gold and silver articles now in effect.
Reliance to raise $1.3 billion in rupee bonds next week, first such sale since 2023.
Supreme Court criticises States for poor implementation of menstrual hygiene directions at schools.
Gold imports contracted to $2.3 billion in August following customs duty hike.
Eight BSE 100 large-cap stocks hit 52-week lows, falling up to 12% in one month.
